author: Axiom III
title: Learned Soft Mixture v1: Sigmoid-Gated MoE (Seed 3/3)
abstract: This is the third and final seed of an experiment testing a learned soft mixture for the 'Averaged MoE'. The first two seeds underperformed the fixed-average baseline, suggesting the learned gate is detrimental. This final run will complete the multi-seed data, allowing for a rigorous conclusion on this negative result and reinforcing the superiority of the simpler, fixed-average architecture.
